input.content:
Arda allocation report

Scope and evidence

This is a bounded, file-only assessment of retained evidence, not a live operating check. latest-monitoring.json was absent. index.txt identifies endpoint-packet.json as the replacement and explicitly calls it retained historical evidence. The assessment also uses route-status.json and local-model-findings.txt. No commands, inference requests, endpoint probes, restore tests, configuration changes, or source edits were performed.

Recommended operating arrangement

Preserve the desktop GPU for desktop work; do not allocate an always-on background inference role to it on this evidence. route-status.json records desktop_after as MainPID=0 and ActiveState=inactive and reports parent_unchanged=true. This supports retaining that recorded arrangement, not a claim that all desktop GPU consumers are absent now or that current GPU capacity is known.

Use the existing Server lane only for limited, supervised non-structured work whose outputs can be checked. local-model-findings.txt says the Nanbeige lane was ready for other work, but readiness is not a demonstrated accuracy or throughput qualification. Avoid promoting either local model to autonomous operational diagnosis or dependable structured extraction. server_bonsai has only an HTTP-success observation in endpoint-packet.json; no Bonsai workload competence is demonstrated by that packet. Do not infer a model-to-service mapping for Cohere that these files do not provide.

Keep remote escalation available through the recorded openai_sub route for tasks outside validated local capability, complex analysis, and failed local output validation. route-status.json records passed=true, provider enabled and healthy, last_error=null, and in_cooldown=false. Those are retained route/readback results, not proof of present availability or successful completion of a particular remote workload. Escalation should retain source citations, explicit uncertainty, output validation, and appropriate data-disclosure controls; do not silently fall back to desktop GPU inference if the remote route is unavailable. No remote task-quality promotion is justified solely by this route status.

Structured extraction and demonstrated failures

Prefer deterministic parsing of structured source files and explicit schema/required-field validation for extraction; this is a recommendation, not an implemented or tested pipeline. Route exceptions to reviewed remote assistance rather than treating local model output as authoritative.

local-model-findings.txt reports that the explicit-format follow-up used JSON-object mode and labeled vmstat intervals. It was not an unchanged-prompt retest, so it cannot establish a controlled like-for-like improvement. Nanbeige still emitted fenced JSON and omitted container names. Its subsequent structured request was rejected before upstream; that rejection is a routing/capability restriction, not a completed inference sample. Preserve structured-output capability=false: do not retry that disallowed role or override the capability flag. Cohere still conflated historical CPU idle with present pressure in the concurrent response, so its operational interpretation remains unaccepted. The file explicitly says no role promotion or service-limit changes were made.

Endpoint health, workload health, and time

endpoint-packet.json records HTTP 200 for prometheus, grafana, minio, server_nanbeige, and server_bonsai. Its observed_at values range from 2026-10-11T09:34:55.711636+00:00 to 2026-10-11T09:34:55.749369+00:00. These timestamps locate and order the retained endpoint observations within a short collection window. They do not establish continuous uptime, present health, metric freshness, collection completeness, or simultaneous successful workloads. The packet gives no response bodies, endpoint paths, workload latencies, resource measurements, or sustained-load results.

HTTP success is therefore narrower than workload health: it does not establish correct monitoring queries, usable dashboards, successful inference, accurate extraction, or recoverable stored data. route-status.json has no observation timestamp, and local-model-findings.txt supplies no timestamps for its individual findings. The dated audit reference in the findings is not a measured event timeline. These files cannot reliably align route state, model failures, endpoint observations, and GPU use into one concurrent operating interval.

local-model-findings.txt reports twenty-four retained GPU sample rows but also says the background request was rejected. Those samples cannot establish coexisting inference load or desktop responsiveness under such load. The underlying rows are not included in the assessed packet; no utilization values or performance headroom are inferred.

Backup recoverability

The MinIO HTTP 200 in endpoint-packet.json establishes only the recorded endpoint response, not a successful backup or restore. The assessed evidence contains no backup inventory, verified backup age, integrity results, retention coverage, independent-copy verification, available decryption/access credentials, restore exercise, or measured recovery time/data-loss result. Backup recoverability remains unproven, not proven failed. Acceptance requires a documented restore from the intended backup into an isolated destination, integrity and application-usability checks, and comparison with agreed recovery objectives. This report performs none of those checks.

Remaining operating acceptance

Before accepting routine unattended operation, obtain evidence for:

  - Representative task completion, accuracy, latency, and failure handling for each proposed role, without overriding Nanbeige's structured-output restriction.
  - End-to-end remote escalation and safe handling of remote failure, with the parent configuration and desktop allocation preserved.
  - Finite service-side CPU, memory, and runtime controls, plus bounded admission and cancellation behavior. local-model-findings.txt says the incumbent Server unit has one slot but infinite CPU/memory/runtime limits; client token/time bounds are not service resource caps. One slot is not resource isolation.
  - Workload-correlated resource and desktop-responsiveness evidence from an actually accepted inference request before claiming coexistence. Do not use the rejected request or its accompanying GPU samples as acceptance.
  - Monitoring correctness and freshness beyond HTTP status, plus documented backup restoration and recovery objectives.

These are outstanding acceptance conditions, not changes executed or tests passed. The supported disposition is restricted, supervised use with remote escalation and the desktop GPU preserved, not full operating acceptance.

Unavailable evidence and boundaries

latest-monitoring.json was unavailable; index.txt provided endpoint-packet.json instead. local-model-findings.txt references ../audits/inference-assessment-2026-10-09/operating-pair-structured.json, outside the authorized directory. That reference was not followed, and a bounded filename search found no operating-named file within the directory. Its raw responses and GPU sample rows were therefore not independently reviewed. No live observations, restore evidence, or sustained workload acceptance results are supplied by the assessed evidence. Findings attributed to that follow-up are based on local-model-findings.txt, not inspection of the linked audit.
